load_config_with_overrides: load a protobuf config from a .prototxt file and apply key=value scalar overrides
load_root_config_meta_cfg: load a MetaCfg root config from a prototxt file with optional scalar overrides applied
save_config_to_prototxt: save a protobuf config message to a .prototxt file using text format serialization
conf_with_overrides_frozen: apply scalar key=value overrides to a frozen config and return a new frozen config
conf_to_dict_json: convert a protobuf config message to a Python dictionary with optional default values included
